electric_shared:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent source atlas for player-owned electrical effects in Rasta Quest. One regular THREE-column THREE-row grid, nine complete separate effects. Each ROW evolves through three frames onset/peak/dissipation with identical anchors, generous transparent gutters. Crisp polished pixel clusters, no blur, glow haze, text, characters or scenery. Color family cyan/ice-white with very dark teal outline, distinct from amber-red hostile effects.
Row1 chain link: a thin angular lightning arc connecting fixed left and right endpoints, chiefly horizontal, endpoints fixed in all three cells, no symbols. Row2 area pulse: thin horizontal ellipse made of sparse jagged electric segments, empty interior with only four short radial ticks, same ellipse footprint across the three keys. Row3 on-kill discharge: compact outward jagged starburst with hollow center, breaks into a few short fading shards by third key. Do not draw a character, axe, enemies, sacred geometry, runes, circles filled with light, fireworks or full-screen obstruction. These are source studies for native export, explicit anchors/lifetimes and reduced-effects review; do not imply gameplay changes.
